digest.component_or_area: reconciler rich-text cutover + outbound field emission + baseline state management
propositions: State-based echo suppression via persisted baseline diffs prevents looping in lossy one-way codecs where decode(encode(x)) ≠ x, keyed on current Jira value vs last-synced baseline rather than inbound-wire round-trip idempotence.

Two distinct compare transforms must be maintained: emit compares normalized remote against normalized local via the codec law (encode then decode), while baseline compares local through normalize_outbound only to match decode(baseline_wire), preventing false 'local changed' signals from re-canonicalization.
Concurrent both-sides edits of the body field preserve rebar-local wins with unchanged local-first behavior, recording both values to the conflict sink and emitting an outbound-field-conflict alert.

An inline change-gated rich_sha counter bounds non-idempotent tail: rich_reemit increments only when emitting with unchanged sha, resets on sha change or baseline refresh, and at threshold=2 triggers exactly one post-push GET overlaid via merge_baseline (sole baseline writer remains _advance_baselines).

Cloud send path and DC send paths (update + create) must compose fit_outbound(to_wire(...)) to emit rendered wire (ADF or wiki) rather than raw Markdown, with rollback via reconciler.rich_text_cutover flag (off/cloud/dc/both, defaults off).

Cutover degrades safely when marklas extra is absent: markdown-aware functions return plain-text ADF results on ImportError, preserving engine's stdlib-only contract and mirroring existing plain-wire fallback behavior.
